validation.name: normal
validation.scope: Full product tests interrupted with SIGINT during bootstrap optional-hold storage tests after647s; all other packages completed successfully. Not a completed full bootstrap suite.

scope: Same deterministic inputs; standalone warm codec microbenchmarks. Separate actual loopback TLS HTTP/1.1 Docker workload. Production unchanged; no WAN/device/long-duration claim.

environment.host: shared with existing services; builds and tests not overlapped with performance trials

method.order: zstd/store/decode before then after; second pair reverse. Rendered HTML measured separately with the same two-pair order.
method.cpu: getrusage RUSAGE_SELF, all threads user+system, divided by b.N; includes Go GC
method.memory: warm allocated bytes per operation and process maximum RSS from wait4; RSS includes fixtures/test harness; cgroup current/peak for HTTP
method.gzip: Go standard library gzip.BestCompression, reused writer, output allocation included; single level9, not production gzip multi-candidate selection
method.archive9: BenchmarkCompressionTarget archive9 retains four fixed profiles to isolate parallel candidate comparison. BenchmarkPackCompressionTarget invokes actual production Level9 including precision optimization.
method.decode: Same decoder implementation; input frames encoded by the corresponding before/after encoder
method.http: WAF enabled, 2 CPUs, 512MiB and 1GiB, prepare 1000 posts at10/s then 20 planned posts/s, 80/20 dedicated/Web, 40 readers, 4s at200 reads/s +12s at2000/s +5s at200/s; reader waits cause skipped arrivals. No capacity burst or crash.

rejected_experiments_scope: Exploratory trials used host defaults in some cases and are not the final paired A/B performance measurements.

rejected_experiments.name: two-way match buckets
rejected_experiments.reason: Size benefit too small; mixed DAT grew and CPU increased.

rejected_experiments.name: short-prefix and match-interior registration
rejected_experiments.reason: Natural text improved modestly, but high-entropy CPU increased substantially.

rejected_experiments.name: bounded hash-chain parser
rejected_experiments.reason: Large CPU increase with larger DAT output.

rejected_experiments.name: klauspost/compress v1.20.1
rejected_experiments.reason: Tested locally at default/better/best, one worker, 1MiB window, low-memory mode and no CRC; did not improve this DAT comparison enough to justify dependency. No dependency added.

rejected_experiments.name: compact table for precision cost calculation
rejected_experiments.reason: Extra state arithmetic did not improve measured latency enough. Existing dense lookup retained.
